1445-4871-6277-8249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6277-8249.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2364-5226-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2364-5226-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Mana Vault, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

236-1436-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
236-1436-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
236-1436-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5075-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5075-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4574-6495-6972.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
4574-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Reclaimer.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Reclaimer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Reclaimer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an artifact card in your graveyard.
If needed, hold priority and repeat step 1 until Arcbound Reclaimer dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
4574-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3899-6517-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-7192.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4211-7895.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Little Bear.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6595-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6595-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

589-5796-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-5796-7743.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
589-5796-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-2292-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Viscera Seer, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

955-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4096-7340.easyPrerequisites: There is an artifact card in your graveyard.
4096-7340.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Sewer-veillance Cam and return another artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice the artifact returned in step 1 and return Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.
4096-7340.notes: You can get infinite creature ETB, LTB, death and sacrifice trigger results if the other artifact is an artifact creature.

1550-2105-4460.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-4460.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1734-2921-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2762-4659-4772.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2060-2744-5660-5686--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-5660-5686--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-5660-5686--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

2034-6662-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

372-1567-2974.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Momentary Blink.
372-1567-2974.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

2558-2981-3490-4050-6701.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2558-2981-3490-4050-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

2921-4681-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

292-3921-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3921-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

813-1799-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding one mana of any color.
When Scholar of the Ages dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Scholar of the Ages from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

803-859-2569-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
"Merfolk" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-859-2569-4289.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

228-678-3558-3701.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Crookshank Kobolds dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

132-198-824-1379.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-824-1379.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {U} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Leech Bonder's ability by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from a creature onto another creature.
Repeat.

423-511-3510-4482.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-4482.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers twice, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

1636-1776-2050.notablePrerequisites:
Spawning Grounds attached to any Forest you control.
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1776-2050.description:
Activate the Forest with Spawning Grounds attached by tapping it, creating a 5/5 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the Forest.
Repeat.

1030-3426-3525-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-3426-3525-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deranged Hermit, adding {1}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Deranged Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Squirrel tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

229-2034-2399-4487.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Phyrexian Marauder.
229-2034-2399-4487.description:
Sacrifice Phyrexian Marauder to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Endless One for {1}.
Sacrifice Endless One to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder for {1}.
Repeat.

224-3177-5233.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

3525-3573-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
You control at least two artifacts.
3525-3573-4348.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

6-3007-5261.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-3007-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-3007-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Toymaker.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
